notes: Copy this file to paths.json. Then edit the paths. paths.json is gitignored. export-env.py refuses a /path/to placeholder. wiki_checkout may be empty. $SUFFIX comes from the build_swift directory name. swift-macosx-arm64 yields test-macosx-arm64/lit.site.cfg. These names are the tested setup on macOS arm64. A Linux x86_64 tree uses the name swift-linux-x86_64. That suffix has not been run off macOS arm64. Set lit_platform only when the directory name is not swift-<os>-<arch>. wiki_checkout is optional. Set it to the case-notes repository, or leave it empty. It is not a Swift project checkout.
